words.engDef: one item of the tools or machines used for a job
words.example: The IT department needs to purchase a new piece of equipment to upgrade the server.
words.chinese: 設備；機器（通常指用於特定目的的實體物品）

words.engDef: the quality of being easy for everyone to reach or use
words.example: The company is committed to improving the accessibility of its website for users with disabilities.
words.chinese: 可及性，指產品、服務或環境能被所有人（包括身心障礙者）輕鬆使用和存取的程度。

words.engDef: to make something start working
words.example: Please activate your account by clicking the link in the confirmation email.
words.chinese: 啟動；啟用；使生效
words.rootPrefix: act (to do, to drive, from agere) + -ive + -ate

words.engDef: the making of something start to work
words.example: Please follow the instructions for product activation after installation.
words.chinese: 啟動；激活；觸發
words.rootPrefix: act (to do, to drive, from agere) + -ive + -ation

words.engDef: a device that lets one piece of equipment connect to another
words.example: I need an adapter to connect my old monitor to the new laptop.
words.chinese: 轉接器；轉換器；適配器

words.engDef: the person or work concerned with running a system
words.example: The IT admin is responsible for maintaining the company's network security.
words.chinese: 管理者；管理員；系統管理員

words.engDef: relating to the air; also a device for receiving signals
words.example: The company is investing in aerial photography to showcase its new resort.
words.chinese: 高空的；空中傳輸的

words.engDef: the first letter of the Greek alphabet; also an early test version
words.example: The company released the alpha version of its new software to a small group of testers.
words.chinese: 阿爾法（希臘字母第一字）；初步測試版；居首位的；主導者
words.rootPrefix: alpha (the first Greek letter, from Hebrew aleph an ox)

words.engDef: using careful examination of the separate parts
words.example: The company uses analytic tools to understand customer behavior.
words.chinese: 分析的；分析性的
words.rootPrefix: ana- (throughout) + lyein (to loosen, Greek) + -tic -> loosened into its parts

words.engDef: a program that runs on a phone or computer
words.example: Our company is developing a new app to streamline the order processing system.
words.chinese: 應用程式，通常指手機或電腦上的軟體應用。

words.engDef: the equipment needed for a particular job
words.example: The company invested heavily in new apparatus to improve production efficiency.
words.chinese: 設備、儀器；一套系統或裝置
words.rootPrefix: ap- (to) + parare (to make ready) -> what is made ready

words.engDef: the yearly rate charged on a loan, shown as a percentage
words.example: The new server boasts an impressive APR of 10 Gbps, significantly improving data transfer rates.
words.chinese: （電腦）每秒處理的資料量，通常以千兆位元（Gbps）為單位，衡量網路或硬體的傳輸速度。

words.engDef: a curved line; also a flow of electricity across a gap
words.example: The bridge has a graceful arc over the river.
words.chinese: 弧形，弧線；弧光；弧形運動；形成弧形，沿弧線移動。

words.engDef: suitable for keeping records over a long time
words.example: The company uses archival-quality paper to ensure documents last for decades.
words.chinese: 歸檔用的；用於長期保存的；符合檔案保存標準的

words.engDef: relating to the air surrounding the earth
words.example: The company is investing in sensors to monitor atmospheric conditions in the data center.
words.chinese: 與大氣層相關的；大氣層的

words.engDef: a recording of a book being read aloud
words.example: Many employees listen to audiobooks during their commute to improve their English skills.
words.chinese: 有聲書；數位音訊書籍，通常用於通勤或學習。

words.engDef: using both sound and pictures
words.example: The presentation room is equipped with state-of-the-art audiovisual equipment.
words.chinese: 結合視覺和聽覺的，指利用聲音和影像共同傳達資訊的。

words.engDef: to prove that something or someone is genuine
words.example: Before accessing the secure server, users must authenticate their identity.
words.chinese: 驗證；確認（身分、資訊等）的真實性

words.engDef: working by itself without a person controlling it
words.example: The company is investing in automated systems to improve efficiency.
words.chinese: 自動化；自動的

words.engDef: to make a process work by machine instead of by hand
words.example: The company is planning to automate several key processes to improve efficiency.
words.chinese: 自動化；使…自動運作

words.engDef: by itself, without a person doing anything
words.example: The system automatically generates reports at the end of each month.
words.chinese: 自動地；不需人工控制地

words.engDef: the use of machines to do work once done by people
words.example: The department implemented innovative automation procedures to improve operational efficiency.
words.chinese: 自動化

words.engDef: able to act independently without outside control
words.example: The company is investing heavily in developing autonomous driving technology.
words.chinese: 自主的；自治的；獨立的
words.rootPrefix: auto- (self) + nomos (a law, Greek) + -ous -> a law to itself

words.engDef: a spare copy of data; also support in reserve
words.example: We regularly back up our data to prevent data loss in case of a system failure.
words.chinese: 備份資料、後援、支援

words.engDef: devices that store and supply electrical power
words.example: The IT department needs to replace the batteries in all the backup generators.
words.chinese: 電池（複數）；電力來源

words.engDef: a test version of software released before the final one
words.example: The software company released a beta version of the new operating system for testing.
words.chinese: （軟體開發中）測試版本；早期版本

words.engDef: a period when the electricity supply fails
words.example: Due to a sudden blackout, we had to postpone the online presentation.
words.chinese: 停電；斷電

words.engDef: a website where someone regularly writes about a subject
words.example: The company uses its blog to announce new product releases and updates.
words.chinese: 部落格；個人或團體定期在網路上發布文章、圖片或影片的個人網站。

words.engDef: a system that connects nearby devices without wires
words.example: The conference room is equipped with Bluetooth speakers for wireless presentations.
words.chinese: 藍牙技術，一種無線通訊協定，用於在短距離內連接電子設備。
words.rootPrefix: Harald Bluetooth (the Danish king who united the tribes)

words.engDef: not sharp or clear to look at
words.example: The screenshot was blurry, making it difficult to read the data.
words.chinese: 模糊不清的；影像不清晰的

words.engDef: a high-speed connection to the internet
words.example: Our company is investing in broadband infrastructure to improve employee productivity.
words.chinese: 寬頻網路，指比傳統撥接電話線路提供更高傳輸速度的網路連接方式，通常用於企業資料傳輸和高速上網。

words.engDef: damaged and no longer working
words.example: The printer is broken, so we need to order a replacement immediately.
words.chinese: 損壞的；故障的；破碎的（指物品或設備無法正常運作）

words.engDef: a program used for looking at pages on the internet
words.example: I use Google Chrome as my default web browser.
words.chinese: 瀏覽器；用於在網際網路上檢視和互動的軟體應用程式。

words.engDef: included as a part of something rather than added later
words.example: The new laptop features a built-in webcam and microphone for convenient video conferencing.
words.chinese: 內建的；整合在設備或系統中的，無需額外安裝或購買。

words.engDef: making a continuous low humming sound
words.example: The server is buzzing, indicating a potential overload.
words.chinese: 嗡嗡作響；持續低沉的聲音（通常指機械或電器發出的聲音）

words.engDef: a camera; also a part that changes rotation into movement
words.example: The security team installed new surveillance cams to monitor the warehouse entrance.
words.chinese: 攝影機；錄影機

words.engDef: a container of ink or other material that fits into a machine
words.example: The IT department needs to order more printer cartridges before they run out.
words.chinese: （印表機、影印機等）墨盒；匣子
words.rootPrefix: cartouche (a paper roll of powder, French, from carta paper)

words.engDef: to look in the instruction book
words.example: If you're having trouble setting up the device, please check the manual for instructions.
words.chinese: 查閱使用手冊；參閱操作說明

words.engDef: small pieces of silicon holding electronic circuits
words.example: The IT department is working to replace the faulty chips in the server.
words.chinese: （電腦）晶片；（食物）薯片

words.engDef: systems of letters or numbers used to represent information
words.example: The IT department is responsible for updating the security codes regularly.
words.chinese: 編碼；程式碼；密碼
words.rootPrefix: codex (a book of laws, first a tree trunk)

words.engDef: made from several different parts or materials
words.example: Modern aircraft often use lightweight composite materials for their structure to improve fuel efficiency.
words.chinese: 綜合的；複合的；合成材料；綜合體

words.engDef: to press something into a smaller space
words.example: To save storage space, IT support asked employees to compress their large image files before uploading them to the shared drive.
words.chinese: 壓縮；縮減（檔案、資料、成本等）

words.engDef: the pressing of something into a smaller space
words.example: Data compression is essential for efficient storage and transmission of large files.
words.chinese: 壓縮；緊縮；壓迫

words.engDef: the working out of an answer using numbers
words.example: The quick computation of results is crucial for real-time analysis.
words.chinese: 計算；計算結果；電腦計算

words.engDef: able to use computers confidently
words.example: To succeed in this role, candidates must be computer literate and proficient in Microsoft Office.
words.chinese: 具備電腦操作能力，熟悉電腦軟硬體及基本應用，能有效利用電腦進行工作。

words.engDef: the changing of a system so computers do the work
words.example: The company's computerization approach needs to be updated.
words.chinese: 計算機化

words.engDef: the use and study of computers
words.example: Our company is investing heavily in cloud computing to improve efficiency.
words.chinese: 計算機科學；電腦運算；資訊處理

words.engDef: to set up equipment or software so it works as needed
words.example: IT support will configure your new laptop with the necessary software.
words.chinese: 設定、配置；調整設定以符合特定需求
words.rootPrefix: con- (together) + figura (a shape) -> to shape the parts together

words.engDef: joined to something else; also linked to a network
words.example: The company's network is connected to the main server for data backup.
words.chinese: 連接的；關聯的；（網路、電話等）已接通的

words.engDef: joining one thing to another
words.example: The IT department is working to connect the new server to the network.
words.chinese: 連接；連結；使聯繫

words.engDef: a part used to join two things together
words.example: Please make sure all the cables are securely plugged into their connectors.
words.chinese: 連接器；連接物；（語法）連接詞

words.engDef: the coming together of separate things
words.example: The convergence of data and voice services allows for unified communication platforms.
words.chinese: 匯聚；趨同；集中；（資訊技術等的）融合

words.engDef: changed from one form or use into another
words.example: The company converted its legacy system to a cloud-based platform to improve efficiency.
words.chinese: 轉換；改變（形式、用途等）

words.engDef: a handle turned to make a machine work
words.example: The technician needs to check the crank handle of the projector before the presentation.
words.chinese: （機械裝置）手把；（口語）發怒，煩躁

words.engDef: sudden failures of a computer; also violent collisions
words.example: The server crashed during the peak hours, causing a significant disruption to our online services.
words.chinese: （電腦系統）當機；（交通工具）撞擊、碰撞

words.engDef: using the most advanced methods available
words.example: Our company invests heavily in research and development to stay at the forefront of cutting-edge technology.
words.chinese: 最先進的；尖端的；領先的（技術或方法）

words.engDef: happening in repeated cycles
words.example: The company is facing a cyclic downturn in sales due to market trends.
words.chinese: 循環的；週期的；按循環發生的

words.engDef: to change a coded message back into ordinary language
words.example: The IT department needs to decode the error message to identify the source of the system failure.
words.chinese: 解碼；破譯；理解（複雜資訊或訊息）

words.engDef: to remove something stored on a computer
words.example: Please delete any unnecessary files from the shared drive to free up space.
words.chinese: 刪除；移除（資料、檔案等）

words.engDef: a demonstration or sample version of something
words.example: Before purchasing the software, we offer a free demo to potential clients.
words.chinese: 示範；演示；試用版

words.engDef: to discover the presence of something
words.example: The security system is designed to detect any unauthorized access to the server room.
words.chinese: 探測；發現；偵測到
words.rootPrefix: de- (un-) + tect (to cover, from tegere) -> to uncover it

words.engDef: able to be noticed or measured
words.example: The new sensor is designed to detect even the slightest traces of pollutants, making it highly detectable.
words.chinese: 可偵測的；可察覺的，通常指透過儀器或方法可以被發現或量測到的。

words.engDef: the discovering of the presence of something
words.example: Early detection of the problem prevented a major system failure.
words.chinese: 偵測；察覺；發現

words.engDef: a device that finds the presence of something
words.example: The security system uses motion detectors to alert personnel to any unauthorized access.
words.chinese: 偵測器；感測器，用於探測或發現特定事物。

words.engDef: short for development or developer
words.example: The development team is responsible for creating new software features.
words.chinese: 開發；研發；(電腦)裝置驅動程式

words.engDef: a person who writes computer programs
words.example: Our company is seeking experienced developers to work on our new mobile application.
words.chinese: 軟體開發人員；負責設計、編寫和測試軟體的專業人員。

words.engDef: pieces of equipment made for a particular purpose
words.example: The IT department is responsible for maintaining all company devices, including computers and smartphones.
words.chinese: 設備；器具；裝置（指用於特定目的的技術工具或機器）

words.engDef: used to find out what is wrong with something
words.example: The IT team used a diagnostic tool to pinpoint the network problem.
words.chinese: 診斷的；診斷學的；診斷
words.rootPrefix: dia- (apart) + gnosis (knowing, Greek) + -tic -> telling one from another

words.engDef: any of the numbers from zero to nine
words.example: The system requires a six-digit security code for authentication.
words.chinese: 數字；位數（尤其指電腦或電話系統中的位數）
words.rootPrefix: digitus (a finger) -> we counted on our fingers

words.engDef: to take a machine apart
words.example: The technician will disassemble the faulty machine to identify the source of the problem.
words.chinese: 拆卸；將...分解開

words.engDef: no longer joined or linked
words.example: The IT department is troubleshooting why several employees' computers are disconnected from the network.
words.chinese: 斷線的；中斷連接的；（電話等）已斷開

words.engDef: separate and distinct from other things
words.example: The system has several discrete components that can be managed independently.
words.chinese: 獨立的; 分開的; 不連續的
words.rootPrefix: dis- (apart) + cret (to sift, from cernere) -> sifted apart

words.engDef: a flat round object; also a device for storing computer data
words.example: Please save your work to a external hard disk before shutting down the computer.
words.chinese: 名詞：圓盤；磁碟；碟盤；動詞：用碟片耕作；用圓盤形物體移動或覆蓋

words.engDef: to change something so it is no longer accurate
words.example: The faulty equipment distorted the audio recording, making it unusable.
words.chinese: 扭曲、變形、歪曲（資訊、數據、圖像等），使其失去原樣或準確性。

words.engDef: a change that makes something inaccurate or misshapen
words.example: The poor signal quality caused a noticeable distortion in the audio.
words.chinese: 扭曲；變形；失真；曲解

words.engDef: a book you read on a screen rather than on paper
words.example: I prefer reading e-books on my tablet because it's convenient for travel.
words.chinese: 電子書

words.engDef: using electronic equipment, especially computers
words.example: The company is transitioning to electronically submitting all expense reports.
words.chinese: 以電子方式地；透過電子設備或系統地

words.engDef: to fix something firmly inside something else
words.example: You can embed the video directly into your website.
words.chinese: 將…嵌入；深植；安插

words.engDef: to send out light, heat, sound, or gas
words.example: The server emits a warning signal when it detects a potential security breach.
words.chinese: （設備、機器等）發出（光、聲音、氣體等）；散發

words.engDef: to change information into a coded form
words.example: The software is designed to encode video files into various formats.
words.chinese: 將資訊轉換為特定格式或密碼；編碼

words.engDef: not working correctly because of a fault
words.example: The IT department is investigating the faulty equipment to determine the cause of the system outage.
words.chinese: 有缺陷的；有故障的；不完善的

words.engDef: recorded film material
words.example: The editor needs to review the film footage to select the best shots for the commercial.
words.chinese: 影片素材；拍攝用的影片片段，通常用於製作影片。

words.engDef: working properly; also practical rather than decorative
words.example: The new software update made the application more functional.
words.chinese: 功能的；實用的；運作正常的

words.engDef: the range of things a product or program can do
words.example: The new software boasts enhanced functionalities, including automated reporting and data analysis.
words.chinese: 功能性；功能特性，指某物或系統所具備的特定功能或效能。

words.engDef: a small useful device or tool
words.example: The IT department is responsible for troubleshooting all employee gadgets.
words.chinese: 小工具；（通常是電子）設備或裝置，通常用於方便或解決特定問題。

words.engDef: produced or created something
words.example: The software automatically generates reports based on the data collected.
words.chinese: 產生；創建；生成

words.engDef: scientific study of genes and how they are passed on
words.example: Our company is investing heavily in genetic research to develop new therapies for chronic diseases.
words.chinese: 基因研究，指針對基因、遺傳機制及遺傳特徵的科學研究，通常涉及生物技術、醫學和製藥產業。

words.engDef: to develop a fault or problem
words.example: The printer went wrong with the new software update, so we need to revert to the previous version.
words.chinese: 出現問題；發生故障；出錯（通常指機械或系統）

words.engDef: pictures and designs, especially made on a computer
words.example: The presentation included compelling graphics to illustrate the sales figures.
words.chinese: 圖像、圖形；視覺呈現資料

words.engDef: a pattern of crossing lines; also a network supplying power
words.example: The city's power grid failed during the storm, causing widespread blackouts.
words.chinese: 網格；方格；輸電網；電網；格狀圖；格柵

words.engDef: to break into a computer system illegally
words.example: The company's database was hacked last night, compromising customer data.
words.chinese: 非法入侵（電腦系統）；劈砍；巧妙的解決方案或訣竅

words.engDef: people who break into computer systems
words.example: The company hired cybersecurity experts to protect against hackers.
words.chinese: 駭客，通常指非法入侵電腦系統或網路以竊取資訊或造成破壞的人。

words.engDef: small enough to be held and used in one hand
words.example: The sales team was provided with handheld scanners to expedite the inventory check.
words.chinese: 手持設備；便攜式設備

words.engDef: the part of a phone you hold; also a mobile phone
words.example: She carefully placed the handset back onto the cradle after finishing the call.
words.chinese: (電話的)聽筒；(無線電話的)話機；手機

words.engDef: kept out of sight or not made known
words.example: The company's financial records were hidden from the auditors.
words.chinese: 隱藏的；被遮蔽的；未被發現的

words.engDef: a small picture on a screen that stands for a program
words.example: The software update introduced new icons for each function.
words.chinese: 圖示；圖標（通常指電腦或應用程式中的圖像，用於代表特定功能或檔案）

words.engDef: to place something inside the body or a system
words.example: The company is planning to implant a new software system to improve operational efficiency.
words.chinese: 植入；安裝（設備、技術等）；（醫學上）移植

words.engDef: being used at the moment
words.example: The new software is currently in use by the marketing team.
words.chinese: 正在使用中；運作中

words.engDef: impossible to reach or to use
words.example: Due to the server maintenance, the company's online portal is currently inaccessible.
words.chinese: 無法存取或到達的；難以接近的

words.engDef: passes a disease or a harmful program to something
words.example: The company temporarily closed the office after several employees were infected with the flu.
words.chinese: 感染；傳染

words.engDef: to take food or information into a system
words.example: The new software can ingest data from multiple file formats.
words.chinese: 攝取；吸收（尤指資訊、數據或食物）

words.engDef: the taking in of food or data
words.example: The accidental ingestion of poisonous berries can be fatal.
words.chinese: 攝取; 攝入; (數據)導入

words.engDef: information put into a computer or system
words.example: The system requires accurate data input to ensure reliable results.
words.chinese: 輸入；數據或資訊的提供

words.engDef: to put equipment or software in place ready for use
words.example: The IT department will install the new software on all employee computers by the end of the week.
words.chinese: 安裝；設置（軟體、設備等）

words.engDef: combined so the parts work together as one
words.example: The company's new software is fully integrated with our existing systems.
words.chinese: 整合的；將…結合的；（系統、功能等）整合的

words.engDef: responding to what the user does
words.example: The company is developing an interactive training module to improve employee engagement.
words.chinese: 互動的；能與使用者產生反應的，通常指數位內容或系統。

words.engDef: to stop or catch something on its way from one place to another
words.example: The firewall intercepted a malicious email attempting to access our network.
words.chinese: 攔截；阻止；中斷（通訊、信號等）
words.rootPrefix: inter- (between) + cept (to take) -> to take it on the way

words.engDef: the point where two systems meet and communicate
words.example: The software's user interface is designed to be intuitive and easy to navigate.
words.chinese: 介面；連接點（通常指系統、軟體或硬體之間的交互點，用於數據或指令的傳輸）
words.rootPrefix: inter- (between) + facies (form, appearance, from facere to make)

words.engDef: a socket into which a plug fits
words.example: Please ensure all laptops are plugged into a power jack before leaving the conference room.
words.chinese: 插座；連接器

words.engDef: sets of keys used to type on a computer
words.example: The IT department is replacing all the outdated keyboards with ergonomic models.
words.chinese: 鍵盤，用於輸入文字和指令的裝置。

words.engDef: a small set of buttons with numbers on them
words.example: Enter your PIN code using the keypad to access your account.
words.chinese: 按鍵盤；數字鍵盤

words.engDef: a room where scientific work is done
words.example: The IT department needs to send the damaged equipment to the lab for testing.

words.engDef: a written account of an experiment and its results
words.example: The quality control department requires a comprehensive lab report for each batch of products.
words.chinese: 實驗室報告，通常包含實驗結果、分析和結論，用於記錄和傳達科學研究或測試的結果。

words.engDef: a person who carries out tests in a laboratory
words.example: The lab technician is responsible for calibrating the equipment before each test.
words.chinese: 實驗室技術員，負責在實驗室協助科學家或研究人員進行實驗、分析樣本和操作儀器。

words.engDef: a room or building where scientific work is done
words.example: The R&D department, or laboratory, is working on a new prototype.
words.chinese: 實驗室；研發部門

words.engDef: a small light used in electronic displays

words.chinese: 引導；領導；（LED）發光二極體

words.engDef: the glass part of a lamp that gives out light
words.example: The IT department needs to replace the faulty light bulb in the server room.
words.chinese: 燈泡；電燈泡（常用於照明或設備指示燈）

words.engDef: to join things so they work as a set
words.example: The IT department is working to link together the company's various databases for better data management.
words.chinese: 將…連結起來；串聯

words.engDef: to enter your details to gain access to a system
words.example: Before accessing the company's internal network, employees must log on to their accounts.
words.chinese: 登入系統或帳戶

words.engDef: the recording of events by a computer system
words.example: The IT department is analyzing the server logs to identify the source of the system error.
words.chinese: 記錄（事件、資料等），通常用於資訊科技領域，指系統記錄操作、錯誤或事件的過程。

words.engDef: the act of entering your details to use a system
words.example: Please login to the company portal using your employee ID and password.
words.chinese: 登入；使用帳戶名稱和密碼進入系統或應用程式。

words.engDef: to read the instruction book to find something
words.example: Before operating the new machine, please look through the manual to ensure proper usage.
words.chinese: 仔細閱讀說明書/手冊，通常為了理解或尋找特定資訊。

words.engDef: a set of instructions a computer runs as one command
words.example: She created a macro to automate the repetitive data entry tasks.
words.chinese: 巨集 (電腦術語，指一組可自動執行任務的指令序列)；宏觀的、巨大的 (作為前綴或形容詞)

words.engDef: a failure to work properly
words.example: The printer malfunctioned during the important presentation, causing a significant delay.
words.chinese: 故障；功能失調（指機械、設備或系統無法正常運作）

words.engDef: relating to machines and how they work
words.example: The factory relies on mechanical automation to increase production efficiency.
words.chinese: 機械的；涉及機器或機械裝置的；不涉及人類技能或判斷的。

words.engDef: having healing properties
words.example: The company is researching new medicinal plants to develop innovative healthcare products.
words.chinese: 與醫療相關的；具有治療作用的

words.engDef: extremely small
words.example: The company decided to invest in micro-financing projects.
words.chinese: 微小的；微觀的；極小的

words.engDef: a device that connects a computer to the internet
words.example: You will need to connect the Ethernet cable to the modem to get internet access.

words.engDef: one separate part that fits with others to make a whole
words.example: The software is designed with reusable modules, making it easier to maintain and upgrade.
words.chinese: 模組；單元；組件

words.engDef: screens that display information; also checks regularly
words.example: The IT department installed new monitors to improve employee productivity.
words.chinese: 監視器；監控設備

words.engDef: a point where lines or connections meet
words.example: Each computer in the network acts as a node, exchanging data with other devices.
words.chinese: 節點；結；重要交會點

words.engDef: having no value; empty
words.example: The search returned a null value, meaning no results were found.
words.chinese: 零值；無效的；空的；作廢

words.engDef: no longer used because something better exists
words.example: The company decided to replace the obsolete software with a more modern system.
words.chinese: 過時的；不再使用的（指技術、設備或方法等）
words.rootPrefix: ob- (away) + solere (to be used to) -> no longer in use

words.engDef: appearing on a computer or television screen
words.example: The presentation will be displayed onscreen for the audience to follow.
words.chinese: 在螢幕上顯示的；在螢幕上的

words.engDef: relating to light or to sight
words.example: The company specializes in developing advanced optical technologies for communication.
words.chinese: 光學的；視覺的；眼睛的

words.engDef: a regular movement back and forth
words.example: The stock market experienced significant oscillation throughout the day.
words.chinese: 擺動; 震盪; 波動; 振盪

words.engDef: not working properly
words.example: The printer is out of order, so please use the one in the conference room.
words.chinese: （機器、設備等）故障、失靈、維修中

words.engDef: a period when a service such as power fails
words.example: The severe storm caused a widespread power outage across the region.

words.engDef: using the internet as the means of doing something
words.example: Our company now accepts payments over the Internet for increased convenience.
words.chinese: 透過網路 (進行交易、溝通等)

words.engDef: to cancel an automatic setting or a decision
words.example: The administrator can override the system's default settings to customize the user interface.
words.chinese: 覆蓋、取代（某規則、指令或系統）；推翻（決定、命令等）

words.engDef: a value that sets the limits of how something works
words.example: The report analyzed various parameters to evaluate project success.
words.chinese: 參數；要素；界限

words.engDef: protected by an official right to be the only maker

words.chinese: 獲得專利保護的；受專利保護的
words.rootPrefix: pat (to lie open, from patere) + -ent -> an open letter of right

words.engDef: on the outer edge; also a device attached to a computer
words.example: The company is launching new peripheral devices, such as external hard drives and printers.
words.chinese: 周邊的；次要的；周邊設備
words.rootPrefix: peri- (around) + pherein (to carry, Greek) + -al -> carried round the outside

words.engDef: the cameras and gear used to take pictures
words.example: The company is investing in new photography equipment to improve the quality of its product images.
words.chinese: 攝影器材，指用於拍攝照片或影片的設備。

words.engDef: the central point on which something turns
words.example: The startup decided to pivot its product strategy to meet changing market demands.
words.chinese: 樞軸；支點；關鍵人物/事物；轉向；以…為軸轉動

words.engDef: the part on a cable that fits into a socket
words.example: The IT department needs to plug the new printer into the network.
words.chinese: 連接器；插頭；插入（動詞）

words.engDef: to connect a device to the electricity supply
words.example: Before using the laptop, remember to plug it in to ensure it has sufficient battery life.
words.chinese: 連接電源；將設備插入電源插座

words.engDef: a recorded programme you can download and listen to
words.example: Our marketing team is launching a podcast to reach a wider audience.
words.chinese: 播客，一種以音頻形式發布的系列節目，通常在網路上提供，供聽眾隨時收聽。

words.engDef: to appear suddenly, especially on a screen
words.example: A notification window will pop up when the software update is ready.
words.chinese: 突然出現；（視窗、廣告等）彈出

words.engDef: something that indicates what is likely to happen
words.example: Age is often a strong predictor of health outcomes.
words.chinese: 預測因子；預報器；預測者

words.engDef: to push a button to make something work
words.example: Please press the button to initiate the software update.
words.chinese: 按下按鈕；啟動按鈕

words.engDef: the part of a computer that carries out instructions
words.example: The company is upgrading its servers with faster processors to improve system performance.
words.chinese: 處理器；中央處理單元 (CPU)，用於執行指令和處理數據。

words.engDef: a person who writes computer programs
words.example: Our company is looking for experienced programmers to develop a new mobile application.
words.chinese: 編程人員；軟體開發者，負責設計、編寫和測試電腦程式。

words.engDef: a regular beat or signal
words.example: The server's pulse rate dropped unexpectedly, indicating a potential hardware failure.
words.chinese: 脈搏；（電腦）訊號、節奏
words.rootPrefix: pellere (to drive, to beat) -> the beat

words.engDef: a system that uses radio waves to find objects
words.example: The shipping company uses radar technology to track the location of its cargo containers.
words.chinese: 雷達，一種利用無線電波探測物體位置和距離的系統，常用於交通、物流和安全監控。

words.engDef: to fill a battery with power again
words.example: The IT department needs to recharge all the laptops before the conference.
words.chinese: 重新充電；恢復能量；補充（電力、資源等）
words.rootPrefix: re- (again, back) + carricare (to load a wagon, from carrus a cart)

words.engDef: the setting up of a system in a different way
words.example: Due to the merger, the IT department is currently undergoing a major reconfiguration of the network infrastructure.
words.chinese: 重新配置；重新調整（系統、設備、流程等）以適應新的需求或環境。

words.engDef: to send something to a different place or address
words.example: Due to the website maintenance, all traffic will be redirected to our temporary landing page.
words.chinese: 將資源或流量重新導向至另一個位置或目標。

words.engDef: to load the latest version of a page or information
words.example: Please refresh the webpage to ensure you are viewing the latest information.
words.chinese: 重新整理；更新（資訊、資料等）

words.engDef: to install software again after removing it
words.example: The IT department will reinstall the operating system to resolve the software conflicts.
words.chinese: 重新安裝（軟體、系統等），通常是因為故障或需要更新。
words.rootPrefix: re- (again, back) + in- (in) + stall (a place, a stand)

words.engDef: the quality of working well and being able to be trusted
words.example: The company emphasizes the reliability of its products to gain customer trust.
words.chinese: 可靠性；可信度；穩定的性能或表現

words.engDef: to copy something exactly, or to repeat an experiment
words.example: The software engineers are working to replicate the bug in the testing environment.
words.chinese: 複製；重現；模仿

words.engDef: a place where things, especially data, are stored
words.example: The development team is responsible for maintaining the code repository.
words.chinese: 儲存庫；檔案庫（通常指用於存放程式碼、文件或其他資料的系統或位置）
words.rootPrefix: re- (back) + pos (to put) + -itory -> the place you put things back

words.engDef: to set a device back to its original state
words.example: The IT department will reset your password after verifying your identity.
words.chinese: 將設備或系統恢復到預設或初始狀態。

words.engDef: to start something again after stopping it
words.example: The IT department will restart the server after applying the security updates.
words.chinese: 重新啟動；再次開始（系統、程序等）

words.engDef: the getting back of stored information
words.example: The database administrator is responsible for ensuring efficient data retrieval.
words.chinese: 檢索；擷取（資料、資訊等）

words.engDef: to change something completely and for the better
words.example: The internet has revolutionized the way we communicate and access information.
words.chinese: 徹底改變；改革；革新

words.engDef: a device or muscle that turns something round
words.example: The machine's rotator is responsible for turning the components during assembly.
words.chinese: 旋轉器；旋轉肌（群）

words.engDef: a device that sends data between networks
words.example: The IT department is upgrading the office routers to improve network speed.
words.chinese: 路由器，用以連接多個裝置並將數據包傳輸到正確目的地的網路設備。

words.engDef: to fill something completely so no more can be taken in
words.example: The server was saturated with requests during the peak hours, causing slow response times.
words.chinese: 使…飽和；使…充滿到無法再吸收的程度；（資訊）使…超載

words.engDef: people who study or work in a science
words.example: Our company employs several scientists to develop innovative software solutions.
words.chinese: 科學家；研究人員（通常指從事科學研究或技術開發的專業人士）

words.engDef: joined so smoothly that no break can be seen
words.example: The software update provided a seamless transition for users, minimizing disruption to their workflow.
words.chinese: 無縫的；流暢的；連接處不明顯的

words.engDef: in a way that shows no break or difficulty
words.example: The new software integrates seamlessly with our existing systems.
words.chinese: 流暢地、無縫地（指過程、系統或技術的整合或執行，沒有明顯的中斷或問題）

words.engDef: in a way that is safe and firmly fixed
words.example: The company's data is stored securely on a cloud server.
words.chinese: 安全地；牢固地；可靠地（指物品或資訊受到保護，不易受到損害或未經授權的存取）

words.engDef: devices that detect changes such as heat or movement
words.example: The factory uses numerous sensors to monitor temperature, pressure, and humidity levels.
words.chinese: 感測器；偵測器，用於感知環境變化並將其轉換為電訊號的裝置。

words.engDef: computers that supply data to other computers on a network
words.example: Our IT department is responsible for maintaining the company's servers.
words.chinese: 伺服器（電腦系統）；（餐飲業）服務員

words.engDef: to arrange or prepare something for use
words.example: The IT department is setting up a new server to handle increased traffic.
words.chinese: 設置；建立；安排；準備

words.engDef: the choices that control how a device or program works
words.example: Please check the printer settings to ensure the correct paper size is selected.
words.chinese: 設定；調整（設備、軟體等）

words.engDef: to turn a machine or business off or close it
words.example: Due to the power outage, we had to shut down the entire server farm.
words.chinese: 關閉（設備、系統等），停止運作

words.engDef: an extra and usually unwanted result of something
words.example: The software update caused several side effects, including slower processing speeds and occasional crashes.
words.chinese: 副作用；不良後果（通常指藥物、治療或產品使用後產生的非預期效果）

words.engDef: to make something behave like the real thing for testing
words.example: The software engineers are using a virtual environment to simulate real-world conditions for testing purposes.
words.chinese: 模擬；模仿；擬真
words.rootPrefix: similis (like) + -ate -> to make it look like the real thing

words.engDef: a model that imitates a real situation for study
words.example: The flight simulator provides a realistic simulation of flying a plane.
words.chinese: 模擬，仿真，模擬物

words.engDef: a place; also a location on the internet
words.example: The company's official website is the primary site for product information and online orders.
words.chinese: 網站；場所；地點（通常指網路上的網站或特定地點）

words.engDef: a narrow opening; also a place in a schedule
words.example: The technician needs to find an available slot in the server rack to install the new hard drive.
words.chinese: （電腦、設備等）插槽；時段；空位

words.engDef: a hollow part into which a plug or bulb fits
words.example: Please plug the charger into the wall socket.
words.chinese: 插座、插孔、插口；窩、臼（如眼窩、關節窩）；安裝（電燈泡等）的座；（電腦的）插槽。動詞：為…裝插座、將…插入插座。

words.engDef: the programs used by a computer
words.example: Our company is investing heavily in new software to improve operational efficiency.
words.chinese: 軟體，指電腦系統中執行特定任務的程式和相關資料。

words.engDef: relating to the sun or powered by it
words.example: The company is investing heavily in solar energy to reduce its carbon footprint.
words.chinese: 與太陽能相關的；利用太陽能的

words.engDef: unwanted email sent to large numbers of people
words.example: Our IT department is working to filter out spam emails to protect sensitive company data.
words.chinese: 垃圾郵件；不請自來的商業廣告郵件

words.engDef: relating to space and the position of things in it
words.example: The company uses spatial analysis to understand customer distribution.
words.chinese: 空間的；存在於空間的

words.engDef: a full range of related qualities or wavelengths
words.example: The full spectrum of electromagnetic radiation includes radio waves, visible light, and X-rays.
words.chinese: 光譜；範圍；系列；領域
words.rootPrefix: spect (to look) + -rum -> what is looked at

words.engDef: to join two pieces of film, rope, or cable together
words.example: They need to splice the broken fiber optic cable to restore internet service.
words.chinese: （將繩、電纜、膠片等）絞接；連接；拼接；結合處；拼接處

words.engDef: a short fast run; also a short period of focused work
words.example: The runner made a final sprint to the finish line.
words.chinese: 短跑；衝刺；（敏捷開發中的）衝刺、短期開發週期

words.engDef: using the most modern methods and technology
words.example: Our company utilizes state-of-the-art software to ensure data security.
words.chinese: 最先進的；尖端的；領先的技術

words.engDef: not moving or changing; also electrical charge that builds up
words.example: The IT department is troubleshooting the static on the conference call line.
words.chinese: 靜態的；不變的；靜電
words.rootPrefix: status (a standing, from stare to stand) + -ic

words.engDef: sound equipment that plays through two or more speakers
words.example: The conference room is equipped with a high-quality stereo system for presentations.
words.chinese: 立體聲系統；立體聲設備

words.engDef: a room where recordings, films, or artwork are made
words.example: The marketing team needs to record the promotional video in the studio.
words.chinese: 錄音室；攝影棚；工作室（通常指用於專業錄製或拍攝的空間）

words.engDef: a smaller set contained within a larger one
words.example: The marketing team analyzed a subset of the customer data to identify key trends.
words.chinese: 子集；（大群體中的）一部分

words.engDef: to change from one setting or option to another
words.example: Please switch the server from the development environment to the production environment.
words.chinese: 將 A 轉換為 B；將設定從 A 更改為 B；切換到 B

words.engDef: to turn a device off
words.example: Please switch off your mobile phones during the presentation to avoid any distractions.
words.chinese: 關閉（設備、燈具等），停止運作

words.engDef: to turn a device on
words.example: Please switch on the projector before the presentation begins.
words.chinese: 開啟；啟動（設備、機器等）

words.engDef: to make two things happen or show the same time together
words.example: The IT department needs to synchronize the data across all servers to ensure data integrity.
words.chinese: 使同步；使協調一致

words.engDef: a labelled section of a screen you can click on
words.example: Click on the 'Pricing' tab to view our different service packages.
words.chinese: 分頁標籤；選項卡（電腦或軟體界面上用於切換不同內容的標籤）

words.engDef: flat handheld computers; also small solid doses of medicine
words.example: The company is providing employees with tablets to improve productivity and facilitate remote work.
words.chinese: 平板電腦，通常指用於工作、學習或娛樂的電子設備。

words.engDef: to separate something into its pieces
words.example: The technician needs to take apart the machine to identify the faulty component.
words.chinese: 拆解；分解；（機械、設備）拆卸

words.engDef: short for technology
words.example: Our company is investing heavily in new tech to improve efficiency.
words.chinese: 科技；技術 (指應用於商業或工業的科學知識)
words.rootPrefix: techne (an art, a skill, Greek) -> tech

words.engDef: knowing a lot about modern technology and how to use it
words.example: Our company is looking for tech-savvy employees to manage our new software systems.
words.chinese: 精通科技、擅長使用科技產品或服務的人。

words.engDef: according to the exact facts or rules; also in a technical sense
words.example: Technically, the software update should be completed by the end of the day.
words.chinese: 從技術上來說；在技術層面上

words.engDef: people trained to look after equipment
words.example: Our IT technicians are available 24/7 to resolve any technical issues.
words.chinese: 技術人員；技師，通常指具備專業技術訓練的人員，負責維護、修理或操作複雜的設備。

words.engDef: the business of sending messages over distance
words.example: The global telecom market is highly competitive.
words.chinese: 電信；電信公司

words.engDef: the sending of messages over long distances by electronic means
words.example: The company invests heavily in the latest telecommunication technologies.
words.chinese: 電信；電訊（指透過電線、無線電或其他電磁系統傳輸訊號、圖像、聲音或訊息的技術）

words.engDef: to broadcast something on television
words.example: The company decided to televise the annual shareholder meeting to reach a wider audience.
words.chinese: 透過電視廣播；將...轉播到電視

words.engDef: a unit of computer storage equal to about a thousand gigabytes
words.example: Our new server has a storage capacity of 2 terabytes, allowing us to handle large datasets.
words.chinese: 太拜特（terabyte）是資料儲存容量的單位，等於 1024 個千拜特（gigabytes），常用於描述硬碟、雲端儲存等設備的容量。

words.engDef: to find and fix faults in a system
words.example: The company's new troubleshoot initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.
words.chinese: 故障排除

words.engDef: abnormal growths of cells in the body
words.example: The company offers comprehensive health insurance that covers the diagnosis and treatment of tumors.
words.chinese: 腫瘤，腫塊（通常指異常細胞生長形成的病變，在商務情境中可能與員工健康相關或影響公司營運）

words.engDef: to stop a device working by using its switch
words.example: Please turn off your mobile phones during the presentation to avoid distractions.
words.chinese: 關閉（設備、電源等）

words.engDef: to disconnect a device from its socket
words.example: Before cleaning the server, remember to unplug it from the power outlet.
words.chinese: 拔掉插頭；斷開電源

words.engDef: to pull a machine's plug out of the socket
words.example: Before cleaning, remember to unplug the device from the power outlet.
words.chinese: 拔除裝置的電源線；關閉裝置電源

words.engDef: to disconnect equipment from the power supply
words.example: Before cleaning, please unplug the equipment to prevent electrical shock.
words.chinese: 拔掉設備的電源插頭；關閉設備電源

words.engDef: brought up to date with the latest information
words.example: The sales report has been updated with the latest quarterly figures.
words.chinese: 已更新的；已修訂的；使…保持最新的（動詞）

words.engDef: new versions or the latest pieces of information
words.example: The IT department will release software updates every month to ensure system security.
words.chinese: 更新；最新資訊（通常指軟體、系統或資料的修正或增補）

words.engDef: bringing something up to date
words.example: The IT department is currently updating the company's software to the latest version.
words.chinese: 更新；使現代化；改進

words.engDef: improved to a better or newer version
words.example: The company upgraded its software to the latest version to enhance security.
words.chinese: 升級；改進（設備、系統、服務等）

words.engDef: improvements to a newer or better version
words.example: The company is offering free upgrades to the latest software version for all its clients.
words.chinese: 升級；改進（設備、系統、服務等）

words.engDef: easy for ordinary people to use
words.example: The new software interface is designed to be user-friendly for all employees, regardless of their technical expertise.
words.chinese: 易於使用；使用者友善的，設計直觀且方便使用者操作。

words.engDef: the book that explains how to use a product
words.example: Before installing the software, please refer to the user's guide for detailed instructions.
words.chinese: 使用者指南；操作手冊，提供產品或服務的使用說明。

words.engDef: a device that controls the flow of liquid or gas
words.example: Please check if the main water valve is fully open to ensure proper water flow.
words.chinese: 閥門；活瓣；真空管
words.rootPrefix: valva (one leaf of a folding door)

words.engDef: the different forms a product or document has taken
words.example: The software company released a new version of their product to address user feedback.
words.chinese: 版本；不同形式或修訂後的同一個產品或文件的不同迭代。

words.engDef: able to be worn, especially of a small electronic device
words.example: Our company is investing heavily in developing wearable technology for employee safety and productivity.
words.chinese: 可穿戴設備，指可以穿戴在身上的電子裝置，通常具有感測器和連接功能，用於追蹤健康數據、提供通知或執行其他任務。

words.engDef: a single document that can be viewed on the internet
words.example: The company's new product information is available on its official webpage.
words.chinese: 網頁；網站頁面

words.engDef: a set of connected pages on the internet
words.example: Our company's website provides comprehensive information about our products and services.
words.chinese: 網站，網路資訊平台，通常用於展示公司資訊、產品或服務。

words.engDef: working without connecting wires
words.example: Our company is transitioning to a wireless network to improve employee mobility and reduce cabling costs.
words.chinese: 無線的；不使用電纜或線的

words.engDef: to function as it should
words.example: The IT department needs to ensure the new software works properly before the launch.
words.chinese: 正常運作；有效執行（指設備、系統或流程）

words.engDef: to compress computer files so they take less space
words.example: Please zip the presentation files before sending them via email to save space.
words.chinese: 將…壓縮成 ZIP 檔案；(電腦檔案) ZIP 壓縮檔案
